## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem or Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds? Describe them here.

## Benefits
How would this feature improve GoalWhisperer AI?
- Benefit 1
- Benefit 2
- Benefit 3

## User Experience Impact
How would this affect the user experience?
- [ ] UI/UX changes required
- [ ] New configuration/setup needed
- [ ] Changes to data format/markdown files
- [ ] API changes required
- [ ] Other: _______

## Implementation Complexity (Optional)
If you have technical knowledge, estimate the complexity:
- [ ] Low - Minor change, quick implementation
- [ ] Medium - Moderate effort, some refactoring
- [ ] High - Significant effort, architectural changes

## Examples or Mockups (Optional)
If you have wireframes, screenshots from other apps, or mockups, add them here.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.

## Related Features
Are there existing features this would build upon or interact with?
